title: 第25章 不可战胜第26章 圣阶戮仙剑阵
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 一点寒芒刺出，晋阳皇子宛如离弦之箭般爆射而出！
面对来势汹汹的晋阳皇子，铜甲木人脸上依旧毫无表情，朴素的一拳猛地轰出，与此前击败其他人时如出一辙。
拳与枪的碰撞，声势惊人。
一声闷哼，自晋阳皇子口中传出，握着长枪的双手，传来了阵阵火辣，整个人更是不受控制的的倒退了三四步，才堪堪止住了身形。
眼中，尽是惊色。
本以为，是此前的那些个挑战者太弱，才会觉得这铜甲木人太强，如今看来，并非如此。
虽然刚才起手那一枪，并不是他的全力，但却也有七成，这一枪，哪怕是七国前三级别的天骄，都得瞬间落败，但铜甲木人，不仅没败，反倒是……震退了他……
这一幕，也在一些人的意料之中，此前挑战木人的那些个天骄，哪一个不是心高气傲，对自己的实力极为自信，觉得并非是铜甲木人太强，而是他们太弱……
结果，一个个的被打脸，如今，即便是大晋帝国的第一天骄，也不例外……
越是如此，那些见识过林玄一剑击败铜甲木人的修士，越是震撼。
铜甲木人越强大，越彰显此前一剑击败它的林玄，实力之恐怖！
“再来！”
晋阳皇子，战意升腾，整个人再次化作一道残影，冲向铜甲木人！
双方，瞬间再次交战在一起。
而这一次，晋阳皇子再无保留，直接动用了全力！长枪挥舞间，隐隐传出龙鸣之声！
但……晋阳皇子强，铜甲木人……更强！！
在它身上，看不到太多声势浩大的招式，但就是那普通到不能再普通的一拳一式，却是硬生生的打得晋阳皇子连连败退……
最终，在交战了近十招后，晋阳皇子最终被轰飞出了木台，败——！
目睹这一幕的众人，极为震撼。
不仅是震惊于晋阳皇子实力之强大，更震惊于铜甲木人的可怕！
全力之下的晋阳皇子，天玄七重的他，足以与天玄九重一战，即便是天玄九重巅峰之境的修士，都不敢说能将其击败，但铜甲木人……却是做到了。
此刻的周围，格外安静，特别是那些初到此地不久之人，连晋阳皇子都败了，还有谁能击败这铜甲木人？
而惨败的晋阳皇子，此时也是陷入了深深的自我怀疑之中。
此战，是他第一次面对同境之时战败，虽然对方并非活人，但他，还是有些难以接受。
“殿下莫要怀疑自己，要老夫说，焚天地尊搞出这等试炼，压根就没打算让人通过，便是焚天地尊还在世，同境之中，他敢说自己能击败这木人？”
“是啊，殿下莫要消沉，这祖树试炼，没准根本不能力取，而是要靠智取……”
“能在它手中撑到第十招才败，试问在场谁能做到？殿下已经很了不起了。”
望着那被打击到，陷入自我怀疑中的晋阳皇子，一些大晋修士纷纷出声。
晋阳皇子，一直以来都是大晋帝国无数修士的骄傲，更是大晋皇帝钦定的下一任皇主，若是因此损了道心，可就得不偿失了，因此纷纷开口劝慰。
“还真有这个可能。”
虽然是安慰的话，但也给众人提了个醒，靠智取而不靠蛮力，还真不是没有可能。
这木人强到不像话，他们想象不出谁能将其击败，那么有没有一种可能……
想要通过试炼，靠的并不是蛮力呢？
“没错，我之前怎么没想到呢。”
有人一拍大腿，觉得定是如此。

虽然她依旧能够击败晋阳皇子，但如木人那般十招击败，怕是很难做到。
如果自己上去，估计能比晋阳皇子撑过更多招，但最终应该还是难以击败这木人。
因此，她的想法其实也和多数人一样，也许，这祖树试炼想要通过，还真不是要靠蛮力，而是有别的一些什么方法？
“如果不是我亲眼见到它一剑被人击败，我还真信了。”只有那些见识过林玄一剑击败铜甲木人那一幕的修士，苦笑摇头……
content_en:
“Buzz——!”
A bit of cold light pierced out, and Prince Jinyang shot out like an arrow from a string!
Facing the menacing Prince Jinyang, the bronze-armored wooden man's face remained expressionless, and he punched out with a simple punch, just like when he defeated other people before.
"Dang——!"
The collision of fists and guns was astonishing.
"Hmph."
A muffled groan came from the mouth of Prince Jinyang, and the hands holding the spear felt hot. His whole body took three or four steps back uncontrollably before he could stop himself.
His eyes were filled with shock.
I thought that it was because the previous challengers were too weak that I thought this bronze-armored wooden man was too strong, but now it seems that is not the case.
Although the shot he fired just now was not his full strength, it was still 70%. With this shot, even the top three geniuses of the Seven Kingdoms would be instantly defeated. However, the bronze-armored wooden man not only was not defeated, but...repelled him...
This scene was also expected by some people. Among the geniuses who challenged the wooden man before, none of them were arrogant and extremely confident in their own strength. They felt that it was not that the bronze-armored wooden man was too strong, but that they were too weak...
As a result, everyone was slapped in the face, and now, even the most talented person in the Jin Empire is no exception...
The more this happened, the more shocked the monks who had seen Lin Xuan defeat the bronze-armored wooden man with one sword were.
The more powerful the bronze-armored wooden man is, the more terrifying the strength of Lin Xuan, who defeated it with one sword before, is revealed!
"Come again!"
Prince Jinyang, with fighting spirit rising, turned into an afterimage again and rushed towards the bronze-armored wooden man!
The two sides were fighting together again in an instant.
But this time, Prince Jinyang no longer held back and directly used all his strength! As the spear was waved, the sound of dragon roar could be heard faintly!
But... the prince of Jinyang is strong, and the bronze-armored wooden man... is even stronger! !
There aren't many powerful moves on it, but those ordinary punches and moves were able to beat the Jinyang prince to defeat...
In the end, after fighting for nearly ten moves, Prince Jinyang was finally blown out of the wooden platform and defeated -!
Everyone who witnessed this scene was extremely shocked.
Not only was he shocked by the strength of Prince Jinyang, but he was also shocked by the terrifying power of the bronze-armored wooden man!
With all his strength, Prince Jinyang, who is at the seventh level of Tianxuan, is enough to fight against the ninth level of Tianxuan. Even the monks at the peak of the ninth level of Tianxuan dare not say that they can defeat him, but the bronze-armored wooden man... did it.
The surroundings are extremely quiet at this moment, especially those who have just arrived here not long ago. Even Prince Jinyang has been defeated. Who else can defeat this bronze-armored wooden man?
The defeated Prince Jinyang also fell into deep self-doubt at this time.
This battle was his first defeat against someone in the same situation. Although the opponent was not a living person, it was still hard for him to accept.
"Your Highness, please don't doubt yourself. I would like to tell you that Burning Heaven and Earth Lord set up such a trial with no intention of letting people pass it. Even if Burning Heaven and Earth Lord is still alive and in the same situation, he dares to say that he can defeat this wooden man?"
"Yes, Your Highness, please don't be depressed. This Ancestral Tree Trial may not be possible at all, but you have to rely on outsmarting..."
"It can last until the tenth move before defeat. Who here can do it? Your Highness is already amazing."
Looking at Prince Jinyang who was struck and fell into self-doubt, some Dajin monks spoke out one after another.
Prince Jinyang has always been the pride of countless monks in the Jin Empire, and is the next emperor appointed by the Emperor of Jin. If he loses his Taoist heart because of this, the gain will outweigh the loss, so they all opened their mouths to console him.
"It's really possible."
Although they are words of comfort, they also serve as a reminder to everyone that it is not impossible to rely on wisdom rather than brute force.
This wooden man is so strong that they can't imagine anyone who can defeat him. So is there a possibility...
If you want to pass the trial, don't you rely on brute force?
"Yes, why didn't I think of it before?"
Someone patted his thigh and felt that this must be the case.
